**Row:** parse-test-summary.sh

**Description:** Shared lib for gate-check.sh + verify-run.sh AC-verdict parsing. Zero-collected or any skipped/todo forces red. Runners: jest, vitest, pytest, node:test, cargo, cargo-nextest, go. Known limit: `go test` without `-v` stays unknown. (CHANGELOG.md)
<!-- /wiki:enrich -->

<!-- wiki:enrich id=orphan-feature-11 fp=orphan -->
<!-- imported from readme/feature-status.md -->
**Row:** run-ledger.sh

**Description:** One JSONL row per cfn-loop-task run (`~/.claude/cfn-data/loop-task-runs.jsonl`, global): tier, `bar_b_tier` (from MEGAPLAN Gates `tier=` token), iterations, lanes, blocked_on + spec-gap classification, out_of_scope count, amendment count, amendments naming a PLAN `Produces` symbol. Prints FLAG lines (`sonnet` + spec gap → re-gate `--bar-b=full`; amendment touches Produces → run check-produce-consume). `stats [--slug] [--last N]` groups by tier. Wired at 5E.6, never gates.
<!-- /wiki:enrich -->

<!-- wiki:enrich id=orphan-feature-12 fp=orphan -->
<!-- imported from readme/feature-status.md -->
**Row:** deferrals.sh

**Description:** Lane deferrals lifecycle (S006, 2026-07-11). New tool for record/gate/resolve: persists blocking items to `.deferrals_<slug>.json`, gates Phase 5 (5E.4a no-open-deferrals check), resolves on backlog. Fail-closed (zero deferrals required by default); cfn-loop-task.md Phase 5 exit gate reads and enforces it.
<!-- /wiki:enrich -->

<!-- wiki:enrich id=orphan-feature-14 fp=orphan -->
<!-- imported from readme/feature-status.md -->
**Row:** cfn-fleet (multi-session coordination)

**Description:** Master session coordinates N worker sessions via file roster: claims, heartbeats, guarded commits, tmux spawn with banner gate, mixed engines (claude-sub/glm/codex), watch events, live-poll dashboard (dark default, filter/sort, now-editing, goal blurb). Codex needs codex=true.
<!-- /wiki:enrich -->

<!-- wiki:enrich id=orphan-feature-15 fp=orphan -->
<!-- imported from readme/feature-status.md -->
**Row:** cfn-tmux-agents (standalone tmux workers)

**Description:** Fleet spawn/send/monitor mechanics without the roster: dedicated tmux socket, one session per agent, literal send-keys, trust/banner/401 gates, engines claude-sub/glm/codex with fleet billing guards incl. the codex delegation gate (refuses without codex=true in target CLAUDE.md). Engine registry read from the shared ~/.claude/cfn-config/engines.env (same file as cfn-fleet). status/capture/list/kill readback. 25 fake-engine tests; all three engines live-smoked 2026-09-10 (banner, prompt, reply, teardown), codex update-modal gate included.
<!-- /wiki:enrich -->

<!-- wiki:enrich id=orphan-feature-16 fp=orphan -->
<!-- imported from readme/feature-status.md -->
**Row:** VERIFY manifest gate

**Description:** Loop done requires verify-run.sh proving every AC green mechanically, manifest unedited since Bar A (sha256 sidecar), no gamed tests, core FRs surviving a mutation probe, and all applicable gate skills run. Re-bless is per-AC scoped: `bless-verify.sh` emits a `regate` line naming only the rows/steps owed (probe only on an added AC); `--force-full` for whole-plan re-gate
<!-- /wiki:enrich -->

**Description:** Opus/Sonnet migration: mechanical gates, pinned contracts, shared agent prelude, dead-ref quarantine (docs/PROMPT_AUDIT_OPUS_SONNET_MIGRATION.md). 2026-07-03 follow-up: agent-builder rewritten as template enforcer (4-section template, validation checklist, never-change-model rule); remaining 17 profiles restructured to conform; full roster now conforming. 2026-07-03 (phase 2): 5 judgment-heavy profiles pinned to opus (root-cause-analyst, goal-planner, system-architect, product-owner, simplifier) for enhanced reasoning on complex decisions

**Description:** VERIFY-manifest executor (run/resolve/summary/backfill-evidence).
